clare: quick sync — we need a small plan for telemetry margin + legal flags when routing across regions. saw a drift in last cutover. need proposals.

sumit: what drift did we see? numbers?

clare: traffic that should have stayed in EU landed in us-west for ~90s during canary swap. legal tag wasn't propagated to fallback route. :grimacing:

devon: that suggests header propagation race. proxy fast-failover kept routing but didn't copy `X-Region-Legal` to the fallback.

irene: timeline: client->edge (eu) -> proxy->primary(eu) lost capacity -> failover proxy->us-west; but proxy had stale route metadata.

sumit: proposal: include legal tag in the signed routing token so it's immutable across hops. add telemetry marker so we can detect when tag changes.

clare: signed token helps but ops wants minimal crypto changes. alternative: sticky header replication at proxy level + validate at runtime and drop if mismatch.

devon: sticky header replication still risks in-flight requests during lease swap. suggest we add a tolerance window: during cutover, allow ephemeral mismatches but capture metric `legal_tag_mismatch` and trigger rollback if >0.1% over 1m.

irene: +1 on metric. also add a dry-run telemetry mode we can enable in prod to log full route traces for 5k rps for 30m. use `X-Route-Debug: trace` header.

clare: sample curl for debug:
```
curl -H "X-Region-Legal: eu-data" -H "X-Route-Debug: trace" https://api.redwood.dev/generate
```

devon: ops playbook change: if `legal_tag_mismatch` spike -> rollback canary and mark tenant for manual review. add alert to oncall.

sumit: I'll sketch the token change + metric. devon can handle telemetry + alerting. irene will run dry-run tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

clare: owners: sumit (token), devon (telemetry+alerts), irene (dry-run). timeline: PRs by EOD, rollout next wed. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: note: scheduled dry-run for 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z by irene (auto-injected).

clare: thanks — will follow up with config snippets in the RFC thread.
